GOAL: find ONE kind Z that is certainly accessible while it has at most 2 traced successes, then never kill from Z again and kill everything from the other 4 kinds + national every day (9/day, all quick afternoon -> 4x multiplier). That is safe forever, because the other 4 contain exactly 2 accessible kinds.
HOW TO FIND Z: clean test days. Kill ONLY the national criminal + the 2 criminals of one untested kind. If deaths_traced rises after that day, that kind is accessible = Z (max 2 successes, safe). If it does not rise, test a different new kind the next day (do not mix kinds on a test day; national never counts in traced). Suggested order: foreign (day 1), forum, cable(age), blotter(sector), regional:West. If all 5 fail, retest kinds (a kind with 0 successes so far can be safely retested once, still max 2).
Once Z is found: every day kill national + all criminals whose reported_in is not Z, quick, afternoon. Skip any criminal listed in Z. Expect pool to fall to about 3000; that is fine. If pool announced at 2000 or below, reconsider (cut to national only).
LOG: Day 1 tested foreign (killed d1-2 national, d1-8, d1-9). Traced count before day 1 = 0. Check press conference after_day 1: if deaths_traced >= 1 -> Z = foreign.
